Pass Cut Replace Drill for Youth Teams
This drill teaches spacing and movement without the ball. Set up three players on the perimeter at the top and both wings. The player with the ball passes to a wing and immediately basket cuts hard to the rim looking for a return pass. The opposite wing replaces the top so the floor stays balanced. The cutter fills out to the open wing. Keep going for one minute and count passes.
Coaching points: cut hard every time, replace the spot behind the cutter, and catch the ball ready to shoot.
